versions.changelog:
Initial release of prompt-bozo: a Chinese-language prompt generator for AI image and video creation tools.

- Supports prompt generation for various workflows: text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, image-to-video, and keyframe video.
- Guides users to provide key parameters (subject, environment, style, action, camera, etc.) with modular templates.
- Includes dedicated logic and references for traditional Chinese aesthetics (e.g. Hanfu, ancient styles, historical costumes, architecture).
- Outputs unified, fluent Chinese prompts tailored by scenario; does not include any additional explanations or labels.
- Includes clear user process, prompt templates, and examples for both image and video workflows.
